value_stream.name: Dangerous Goods (DG) & Hazardous Materials Transport, Ecommerce & Regulatory Compliance

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, HSE (links to VS-24), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Compliance/Regulatory (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Sustainability (links to VS-25)
fields.Trigger: Annual compliance/HSE planning (links to VS-24/VS-22); regulatory change

Automation Opportunity: - System continuous audit of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE define the DG compliance program strategy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Logistics ships, Ecommerce lists, DC/Store stores, HSE protects workers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve the DG program strategy and policy, ratify governance/authorities,…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: DG Compliance Officer authority; operational: risk-committee reporting and quantified exposure
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fragmented-ownership risk**: DG compliance split across HSE/Logistics/Ecommerce with no single owner; mitigated by DG Compliance Officer authority
- **Under-prioritization risk**: DG risk under-resourced until an incident; mitigated by risk-committee reporting and quantified exposure
System Touchpoints: - HSE (links to VS-24); compliance/regulatory (links to VS-22); legal (links to VS-100.3); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); finance (links to VS-34/VS-17.4); sustainability (links to VS-25)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE define the DG compliance program strategy and governance: scope (the DG-intensive categories — paint/solvents, adhesives/thinners, aerosols, garden chemicals, cleaning chemicals, fuels/lubricants, gas cylinders, lithium batteries, cement/silica), the regulatory map (DENR-EMB RA 6969, BFP Fire Code, DOLE OSH, MARINA/Coast Guard, CAB, LTFRB/DOTr, IMDG/IATA/ADR), the program operating model, and the KPIs (compliance %, incidents, carrier refusals, audit findings)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer establish the DG governance: DG Compliance Officer role/authority, the DG committee, cross-functional responsibilities (Merchandising classifies, Logistics ships, Ecommerce lists, DC/Store stores, HSE protects workers), the policy/standards, and the integration to HSE (VS-24.3), quality (VS-31), and recall (VS-89)

VP Legal/COO approve the DG program strategy and policy, ratify governance/authorities, allocate the program budget (links to VS-34/VS-17.4), and report DG compliance posture to the executive risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36) and board (links to VS-36); communicate the mandate

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Merchandising/Category (links to VS-01), Private Label (links to VS-41), Master Data (links to VS-29), Quality (links to VS-31), Import (links to VS-87), Supplier, Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03)
fields.Trigger: New SKU/NPI (links to VS-01.1); vendor/private-label onboarding; regulatory update

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-classify of "classify each DG SKU against the modal regulations" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "flag, transport-eligibility by mode" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate classification for private-label and high-risk SKUs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-571 (ensure controlled execution — DG Classification, Inventory & Program Governance (PA-114.1).)
- operational: expert classification and validation; operational: mandatory DG attributes at SKU setup; operational: DG attributes at SKU setup
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-classification risk**: Wrong UN/class causes non-compliant shipment and incident; mitigated by expert classification and validation
- **Master-data gap risk**: DG attributes not on the item master block automated compliance checks; mitigated by mandatory DG attributes at SKU setup
System Touchpoints: - Item/hazmat master (links to VS-29); NPI/lifecycle (links to VS-01.1); private label (links to VS-41); quality (links to VS-31); SDS/chemical info (links to W3595); ecommerce listing (links to VS-10/W3604); transport (links to W3602)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Merchandising classify each DG SKU against the modal regulations: UN number, proper shipping name, hazard class/division (1–9), packing group (I/II/III), subsidiary risks, special provisions, and the modal-specific classification (IMDG sea, IATA air, ADR/DOT road); obtain vendor/manufacturer classification or commission expert classification

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Master Data capture the DG classification in the item/hazmat master (links to VS-29): UN number, class, packing group, DG flag, transport-eligibility by mode (air/sea/road), ecommerce ship-eligibility flag (W3604), restricted-quantity/limited-quantity thresholds, and the linked SDS (W3595); maintain through the product lifecycle (links to VS-01.1)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Quality validate classification for private-label and high-risk SKUs (links to VS-41/VS-31), manage classification disputes/updates on regulatory change (W3596), and feed classification to transport (W3602–W3605), ecommerce (W3604), and storage (W3609) compliance; audit classification accuracy

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Quality (links to VS-31), HSE (links to VS-24.3), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Master Data (links to VS-29), Supplier, Store/DC Operations
fields.Trigger: SKU classification (W3594); SDS update; regulatory change

workflows.name: Hazmat Inventory, SDS & Chemical Information Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "toxicology, ecological, disposal, transport" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to the hazmat master" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates on formulation/regulatory change, supplier SDS accuracy audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-571 (ensure controlled execution — DG Classification, Inventory & Program Governance (PA-114.1).)
- operational: coverage KPIs and supplier obligation; operational: register and reporting discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **SDS-gap risk**: Missing/outdated SDS blocks safe handling and compliance; mitigated by coverage KPIs and supplier obligation
- **Chemical-inventory-reporting risk**: Failure to report DENR-EMB inventory attracts penalty; mitigated by register and reporting discipline
System Touchpoints: - SDS/chemical library; hazmat master (links to W3594/VS-29); DENR chemical inventory (links to VS-24.3/VS-22); quality (links to VS-31); worker access (links to VS-24/W3597); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Quality obtain and maintain the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each chemical/DG SKU: GHS-compliant SDS (16-section), hazard identification, composition, first-aid, fire-fighting, accidental-release, handling/storage, exposure/PPE, stability, toxicology, ecological, disposal, transport (links to W3594), regulatory; multi-language where imported; supplier-sourced

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE maintain the chemical inventory and register (DENR-EMB Chemical Inventory Report under RA 6969, Priority Chemical List where applicable), the SDS library (accessible to DC/store/workers links to VS-24.3), and the chemical information feed to transport/storage/ecommerce compliance; reconcile to the hazmat master (W3594)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Quality manage SDS updates on formulation/regulatory change, supplier SDS accuracy audit (links to VS-31/VS-67), and SDS availability/acknowledgement by workers (links to VS-24/W3597); report SDS coverage and gaps to governance (W3616)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Compliance/Regulatory (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Government Affairs (links to VS-104), Import (links to VS-87), HSE (links to VS-24), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110)
fields.Trigger: Regulatory monitoring cycle; regulatory change notice

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor DG regulatory developments" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer assess the impact of regulatory change" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate compliance and report to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: monitoring and association engagement; operational: change-impact plan and validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-awareness risk**: Regulatory change detected after non-compliance; mitigated by monitoring and association engagement
- **Inconsistent-implementation risk**: Change known but not applied across master data/operations; mitigated by change-impact plan and validation
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/regulatory change (links to VS-22.3); legal (links to VS-100.3); government affairs (links to VS-104); master data (links to W3594/VS-29); carrier (links to W3601); ecommerce (links to VS-10/W3604)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Compliance monitor DG regulatory developments: DENR-EMB rules/RA 6969 amendments, BFP Fire Code, DOLE OSH, MARINA/Coast Guard sea-DG, CAB air-DG, LTFRB/DOTr road-DG, international modal updates (IMDG/IATA/ADR biennial updates), and LGU ordinances; source from regulators, associations (links to VS-104), and counsel

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer assess the impact of regulatory change on BuildRight: classification updates (W3594), packaging/marking (W3598), transport rules (W3601–W3603), ecommerce eligibility (W3604), storage (W3609), training (W3597), and reporting; produce the change-impact assessment and compliance plan

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer implement the compliance plan: update master data/SDS (W3594/W3595), standards (W3598), carrier contracts (W3601), ecommerce rules (W3604), and training (W3597); validate compliance and report to governance (W3616) and the regulatory-change process (links to VS-22.3)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, HSE (links to VS-24), HR/L&D (links to VS-19.3/VS-103), Logistics (links to VS-06), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Store Operations (links to VS-07)
fields.Volume: DG-handling workforce (DC hazmat staff, drivers, ecommerce packers, store paint/chemical staff, supervisors)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/L&D deliver the DG training" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track certifications/expiry, manage refresher/re-certification, and audit…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: certification gating and register; operational: expiry tracking and refresher
Pain Points / Risks: - **Untrained-handler risk**: Uncertified staff shipping/handling DG breaches regulation and risks incident; mitigated by certification gating and register
- **Certification-lapse risk**: Expired IATA/IMDG certification invalidates shipments; mitigated by expiry tracking and refresher
System Touchpoints: - HR/L&D (links to VS-19.3/VS-103); HSE/PPE (links to VS-24); records (links to VS-88); competency register; logistics/DC/store/ecommerce operations

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE define DG training and certification requirements by role: hazmat handler, DG driver (hazmat endorsement), DG shipper/consignor (IATA/IMDG certified), ecommerce DG packer, supervisor, and emergency responder; align to DOLE OSH and modal rules (IATA requires trained shippers)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/L&D deliver the DG training: classroom/e-learning, hands-on handling/PPE (links to VS-24), spill response (W3611), documentation (W3602), and modal-specific (IMDG/IATA/ADR); certify and record completion; manage external certifications (IATA shipper, DENR-accredited training)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE maintain the DG training/competency register, track certifications/expiry, manage refresher/re-certification, and audit competency coverage; feed gaps to L&D (links to VS-19.3) and HR (links to VS-103); report to governance (W3616) and audit (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Packaging Eng (links to VS-111), Quality (links to VS-31), Import (links to VS-87), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Supplier, Private Label (links to VS-41)
fields.Trigger: SKU classification (W3594); packaging spec; regulatory change (W3596)
fields.Volume: DG-intensive SKUs requiring UN-certified transport packaging

workflows.name: DG Transport Packaging, Marking & Labeling Standards

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-test of "tested to the packing group" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate DG packaging/marking compliance on incoming" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-571 (ensure controlled execution — DG Classification, Inventory & Program Governance (PA-114.1).)
- operational: packaging spec and incoming validation; operational: marking spec and audit
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-UN-packaging risk**: Non-certified packaging causes leak/incident and carrier refusal; mitigated by packaging spec and incoming validation
- **Marking/label error risk**: Wrong/missing hazard labels cause handling error; mitigated by marking spec and audit
System Touchpoints: - Packaging master/BOM (links to VS-111/VS-29); quality/inspection (links to VS-31); private label (links to VS-41); vendor compliance/chargeback (links to VS-03); transport documentation (links to W3602); ecommerce (links to W3604)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Packaging specify the DG transport packaging per SKU: UN-certified packaging (design-type tested to the packing group), inner/outer packaging, absorbents for liquids, quantity limits (limited-quantity/excepted-quantity thresholds), and compatibility; align to IMDG/IATA/ADR packaging instructions

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Packaging specify the DG marking and labeling: UN number marking, proper shipping name, hazard class labels (diamond labels), orientation arrows, "LQ"/"EQ" marks, lithium-battery handling marks, and overpack marking; specify placarding for transport units (links to W3602); align to modal rules

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Quality validate DG packaging/marking compliance on incoming (links to VS-31) and private-label (links to VS-41), audit vendor compliance (W3525-style), manage non-compliance and chargeback (links to VS-03), and capture the spec in the item/packaging master (links to VS-111/VS-29); feed to transport (W3602) and ecommerce (W3604)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Procurement/Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87), Private Label (links to VS-41), Quality (links to VS-31), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Logistics (links to VS-06)
fields.Trigger: Vendor/private-label onboarding (links to VS-03.1/VS-41); import PO (links to VS-02.2/VS-87)
fields.Volume: DG vendors and DG import shipments (~40% import)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Vendor Mgmt incorporate DG compliance into vendor/private-label" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "Import ensure DG import compliance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track vendor DG performance in the scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: onboarding obligation and audit; operational: pre-shipment compliance check
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vendor-non-compliance risk**: Supplier ships DG without proper classification/packaging/docs; mitigated by onboarding obligation and audit
- **Import-block risk**: DG import blocked at port for non-compliance; mitigated by pre-shipment compliance check
System Touchpoints: - Vendor onboarding/portal (links to VS-03.1/VS-03.4); import/customs (links to VS-02.2/VS-87); quality (links to VS-31); legal (links to VS-100.3); chargeback (links to VS-03/VS-90); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67); port handling (links to W3607)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Vendor Mgmt incorporate DG compliance into vendor/private-label onboarding (links to VS-03.1/VS-41): vendor obligation to provide accurate classification (W3594), SDS (W3595), UN-certified packaging/marking (W3598), and transport documentation (W3602); supplier qualification for DG; contractual compliance and indemnity
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Vendor Mgmt / Legal

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Import ensure DG import compliance: import classification/customs (links to VS-87), DG import documentation, port/terminal DG handling (links to W3607), IMDG sea-transport compliance (W3603), and DENR import notification/permit for regulated chemicals; coordinate with broker (links to VS-02.2)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Quality audit DG vendor/import compliance, manage non-compliance and chargeback (links to VS-03/VS-90), and track vendor DG performance in the scorecard (links to VS-67); report vendor/import DG risk to governance (W3616)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Quality / Vendor Mgmt

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Audit (links to VS-21), Compliance (links to VS-22), Records (links to VS-88), HSE (links to VS-24), Logistics (links to VS-06), Legal (links to VS-100.3)
fields.Trigger: Annual audit cycle; regulatory inspection; incident

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Audit maintain the DG documentation and records" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation completeness, storage compliance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer manage findings to closure, support regulatory" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: documentation discipline and retention; operational: closure tracking and governance reporting
Pain Points / Risks: - **Records-gap risk**: Missing DG records fail audit/inspection; mitigated by documentation discipline and retention
- **Audit-finding-accumulation risk**: Findings not remediated; mitigated by closure tracking and governance reporting
System Touchpoints: - Records/retention (links to VS-88); audit (links to VS-21); regulatory inspection response (links to VS-22); governance (links to VS-36); risk (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Audit maintain the DG documentation and records: classifications (W3594), SDS (W3595), training records (W3597), transport documents (W3602), carrier agreements (W3601), incident reports (W3613), permits (W3614), and DENR/DOLE/BFP filings; retention per regulation and VS-88 (typically 3–10 years)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Audit conduct the annual DG compliance audit: classification accuracy, SDS coverage, training currency, packaging/marking compliance, transport-documentation completeness, storage compliance (links to VS-24.3), ecommerce eligibility (W3604), and incident closure; internal and third-party/DENR-accredited

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer manage findings to closure, support regulatory inspections (DENR-EMB/DOLE/BFP/MARINA/CAB) and audit response (links to VS-22/W77), and report DG audit posture and findings to governance (W3616), audit committee (links to VS-21/VS-36), and risk (links to VS-21.2)
